bind_address.description: Local IP address on which to listen for incoming DNS queries (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only, or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

bind_port.description: Port number for the DoH resolver listener.

items.description: A DNS upstream resolver (DoH, DoT, or plain DNS).

server.description: Full URL (DoH) or host:port (DoT, e.g., 'dns.cloudflare.com:853') of the upstream resolver.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this upstream.

tls_servername.description: Optional TLS server name (SNI) for DoT or DoH connections (e.g., 'dns.google').

upstreams.description: List of upstream DNS resolvers to forward queries to. Supports DoH (HTTPS), DoT (TLS), or plain DNS (deprecated).

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Set to empty string ('') to log to stdout.

max_queries_per_client.description: Maximum queries allowed per client IP per second (0 = unlimited). Helps prevent abuse.

ecs.description: Enable EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) support to pass client network info to upstream resolvers.

dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation. Requires upstream support and a trust anchor file.

trust_anchor_file.description: Path to the root DS (Delegation Signer) records file, used for DNSSEC validation.

timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for upstream DNS queries and HTTP connections.

cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format) for the DoH HTTPS endpoint.

key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format, unencrypted).

sni_hostname.description: Optional SNI hostname for TLS. If omitted, defaults to bind_address.

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for upstream queries and client connections.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum number of queries allowed in a burst before rate limiting kicks in.

rate_limit_window.description: Time window (in seconds) for rate limiting calculations.

cache_size.description: Maximum number of DNS responses to cache (0 = disable caching).

cache_min_ttl.description: Minimum TTL (seconds) to cache a response (overrides low TTL values).

cache_max_ttl.description: Maximum TTL (seconds) to cache a response (overrides high TTL values).

ip.description: IP address to return for the hostname (IPv4 or IPv6).

hosts_file.description: Static hostname-to-IP mappings to override upstream resolution (e.g., for local devices).
